title: T-Bone Walker at the Three Sixes
summary: First seeing T-Bone Walker at the Three Sixes and crediting him with opening up guitar playing.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: And later on, they built a club called the Three Sixes on East Adams. That's where I first saw the legendary T-Bone Walker doing his trip down there. And he was something

special. Actually, T-Bone opened up the guitar players. All the guitar players out today playing guitar owe T-Bone a debt of gratitude, because he really helped them. Do you remember the thing he made with Freddie Slack? I can't remember the name of the song. Anyway, he played a classic solo, and every guitar player since then has played some parts of that solo.
